title: Spec: Markus after Jinja wiki render pipeline
description:
Acceptance specs for the wiki rendering architecture:

1. Jinja first — live issue-index helpers evaluate templates.
2. Markus second — anthus-markus / markusmd.convert converts Jinja-resolved Markdown to semantic HTML.
3. Console preview consumes backend-rendered HTML with Markus classes; browser styles only.
4. Unknown directives fail validation.

Requested card id kbs-5d88eb was not present on this develop board; this story continues that work. Specs originated in PR 217.

comments.author: ubuntu
comments.text:
